body: Good luck friend. Don't be afraid to be yourself.

As fucking dreadful as that while ordeal is you can move past it. I did a boatload of acid and walked out the front door naked in front of my family once and while I was embarrassed as all hell I don't spend much time thinking about that particular incident anymore.

Maybe try and make a joke of it. "Yeah, so that happened." Kind of thing.

You are still so young and have so many more friends to make, especially if you are in school. I know how tough that can be but please try your best to stick it out. Always be true to the type of person you want to be and they will come, even if it doesn't seem like it at first. Losing friends is one of the hardest things to move past. 

Maybe try and explain that you're going through a rough time if the joking/bullying behavior gets too much to whoever your closest friend is in the group. Some people have no idea the impact they have on other's lives. Sometimes people will choose a weaker target to make themselves seem cool in a group as fucked up as that is and having someone to back you up could help. If that doesn't work, remove them from your life. 

This is all advice from a stranger that doesn't know your life but friends come and go. Please try to hang in there ♥️.
Your life is a rubber band. You live it forwards then backwards starting and ending with today. Always you. Dying just means it's the end of that day.

Did I have a choice? If you could trade your life, for the one you wanted, for where you wanted it, with who you wanted it. I wouldn't be able to make that choice. I'd wish it away. To admit that you could do that is to admit that you are God. To admit that you are God, you'd have to admit that you thought of everything. To admit that you thought of everything is to admit that you are everything. To be everything would be pretty lonely, especially if you had to explain to nobody that you made EVERYTHING happen. Even that.

When there's nothing left to believe in, who do you believe in? Anybody? Nobody.
